metaDescription: CPT 99487 explained: complex CCM for patients needing 60 minutes of clinical staff time and moderate to high decision-making. Rules, rate and audit gaps.
summary: Complex CCM covers a higher-intensity month: at least 60 minutes of clinical staff time, moderate or high complexity medical decision-making, and a care plan that is established or substantially revised.
time: 60 minutes of clinical staff time per calendar month
performer: Clinical staff under the billing practitioner's direction
frequency: Once per patient per calendar month, by one practitioner
requirements: Two or more chronic conditions expected to last at least 12 months or until death, with significant risk of decline
Moderate or high complexity medical decision-making documented by the practitioner
Establishment or substantial revision of the comprehensive care plan that month
Documented consent and a time log reaching 60 minutes
pitfalls: Using 99487 when the care plan was not actually revised that month
No documented decision-making level to support the code
Billing 99487 and 99490 together for the same patient and month
conflicts: Used instead of 99490 for the same patient and month, not alongside it.

faqs.question: When should a practice use 99487 instead of 99490?
faqs.answer: When the month needed at least 60 minutes of staff time and the practitioner's decision-making and care plan changes were moderate to high complexity. Otherwise the base code applies.

faqs.question: Does the complex code pay more than the base code?
faqs.answer: Yes, roughly double the base rate nationally. Actual amounts vary by locality and payer.
